# CEL 0.14.3 local patch

Upstream: https://github.com/cel-rust/cel-rust, crates.io cel 0.14.3 (MIT according to its published Cargo.toml). Cargo.lock previously pinned this exact release (registry checksum `f82399e72d100a28a0cac14251a8aba16d124af2a237d8a60ab7997ba7380cc3`). No dependency version or CEL grammar change.

`src/parser/parser.rs` extends the existing recursion listener to account for left-recursive member, calculation and relation operators before AST construction. Completed child depths are propagated bottom-up; sibling width and qualified constructor names are not depths. The existing recursion bound and post-expansion AST bound remain authoritative. This prevents unbounded parse trees/visitor recursion on the caller stack without a dedicated 32 MiB thread. All other source files are unchanged from the release. The crate archive did not include a LICENSE file; the upstream notice is included from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cel-rust/cel-rust/master/LICENSE (retrieved 2026-09-11). The archived VCS revision is `3bea37e375b8c28cae729de9cf2e8aff2846159f`, path `cel`; its LICENSE URL was not retrievable, so the notice is attributed to the upstream master source, not claimed to be bundled in the crate archive.
